source: Nebius press release: Palantir and Nebius partner to deliver a complete sovereign (09-08-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner under a strategic partnership: following an integration period, Palantir will bring Nebius compute and inference endpoints inside the Palantir enterprise perimeter so eligible Palantir commercial customers can run and adapt open models on Nebius infrastructure, and the two companies will work together to accelerate deployment of new compute capacity for Palantir customers, including modular data-center deployments at sites where power is already available. No contract value is stated.
